summary: Secure for the audited Street Glass scope: client writes cannot set or mutate match penalty scores or knockout decisions; bracket seeding and BYE inputs are strictly typed, bounded, unique, and ownership-scoped; tie resolution and winner/champion transitions are backend-only; strict schemas reject extra bracket/tie fields. Evidence: 178/178 Firestore Rules emulator tests passed, 29/29 settlement and approval function tests passed, and the Firebase CLI rules dry run compiled successfully for el7reef-app. This is a scoped prototype audit and should still be reviewed before broad production rollout.
